pathways.title: Adapt: AI-assisted customer care specialist
pathways.summary: Stay in customer service, use AI assistants for routine drafting and record-keeping, and specialise in the complex, emotional and multilingual cases that customers still want a person to handle.
steps: Learn the AI assistant and knowledge tools your employer uses, and practise checking their suggestions before sending
Volunteer for escalations and complaints to build complex problem-solving experience
Strengthen service in more than one language, for example English and Kiswahili
Track your quality and resolution results to show you can handle difficult cases

evidence.note: AI assistance raised productivity most for novice agents, suggesting AI can speed up learning on the job (outside Africa).
Even in a heavily automated deployment, customers could still choose live agents (company statement, outside Africa).

pathways.title: Transform: Conversation designer or CX quality analyst
pathways.summary: Move from answering conversations to improving them: design chatbot flows, maintain the knowledge base AI tools rely on, and review automated conversations for quality and fairness.
steps: Document the questions customers ask most and the answers that work
Learn the basics of conversation design and knowledge-base writing
Join quality reviews of automated or AI-assisted conversations
Build a small portfolio: an improved FAQ, a chatbot flow, or a quality report

evidence.note: AI and big data and technology literacy are among the fastest-growing skills employers expect.

pathways.title: Discover: Customer data and digital operations
pathways.summary: Use your knowledge of customers and service systems as a bridge into data analysis or CRM administration, roles that turn service data into decisions.
steps: Learn spreadsheets and basic SQL using exported service data (with personal data removed)
Build dashboards of common complaint types or resolution times
Take an introductory data-analysis course
Apply for junior analyst or CRM administrator roles, internal ones first

evidence.note: Data analysts and scientists are among the fastest-growing jobs for 2025-2030.

pathways.title: Adapt: Tech-enabled accountant
pathways.summary: Let software and AI take the routine processing, and focus on review, certification, tax judgement and explaining the numbers to clients.
steps: Master the accounting and tax software used by your clients or employer
Practise reviewing AI-drafted reconciliations and statements for errors
Deepen tax and regulatory expertise, where judgement is hardest to automate
Offer clearer client explanations and advice alongside compliance work

evidence.note: Statement preparation scores higher on exposure than tax advice, investigations and audit.

pathways.title: Transform: Forensic accounting, audit and risk
pathways.summary: Move toward the least exposed parts of accountancy: investigations, audit and risk, using data analytics to examine whole transaction sets.
steps: Build data-analysis skills for auditing (spreadsheets, SQL, audit analytics tools)
Seek audit or internal-control assignments
Study fraud examination and forensic accounting
Develop interviewing and evidence-documentation skills

evidence.note: Financial investigations (0.415) and auditing (0.4335) are the least exposed accountancy tasks.

pathways.title: Discover: Fintech and financial data roles
pathways.summary: Combine financial knowledge with technology in fintech products, financial data analysis or business intelligence. Kenya's mobile-money ecosystem shows how financial technology can reshape an economy.
steps: Learn how digital payments and mobile money products work
Build business intelligence and data-visualisation skills
Complete a project analysing financial data for a small business
Explore roles at fintech companies, banks' digital units and payment providers

evidence.note: FinTech engineers and data analysts are among the fastest-growing jobs.
M-Pesa in Kenya increased financial inclusion and helped propel SME growth.

pathways.title: Adapt: AI-augmented developer
pathways.summary: Use AI pair programmers to move faster, and become the person who can judge, test and secure AI-generated code.
steps: Use an AI coding assistant on personal projects and review every suggestion
Strengthen testing and code-review habits for AI-generated code
Learn secure coding basics to catch vulnerabilities AI tools may introduce
Contribute to open-source projects to practise reviewing others' code

evidence.note: AI pair programmers sped up a defined coding task by 55.8% (outside Africa).
Testing and requirements analysis are the most exposed developer tasks.

pathways.title: Transform: AI and machine learning engineering
pathways.summary: Move from using AI tools to building AI-powered products, including for African languages and markets.
steps: Learn the fundamentals of machine learning and model evaluation
Build an application that uses an AI model to solve a local problem
Learn how to deploy and monitor models responsibly
Follow and contribute to local-language AI initiatives

evidence.note: AI and machine learning specialists are among the fastest-growing jobs.
Announced investment in local-language AI model development and AI skills training in Kenya.

pathways.title: Discover: Security and DevOps
pathways.summary: Apply engineering skills to protecting and operating systems, areas where the WEF projects fast growth.
steps: Learn Linux, networking and cloud fundamentals
Practise in capture-the-flag challenges or a home lab
Automate deployments for a personal project with CI/CD
Pursue an entry-level security or cloud certification

evidence.note: Security management specialists, information security analysts and DevOps engineers are among the fastest-growing jobs, and networks and cybersecurity is the second-fastest-growing skill.

pathways.title: Adapt: AI-literate teacher
pathways.summary: Use AI to save time on preparation and differentiation while keeping teaching, relationships and assessment decisions in human hands, following privacy and age-appropriate safeguards.
steps: Try AI tools for drafting lesson materials and check them against the syllabus
Learn your school's and UNESCO's guidance on data privacy and student use
Teach students to question AI output
Share what works with colleagues in a short professional-learning session

evidence.note: Calls for a human-centred approach, data-privacy protection and age limits for independent use.
Curriculum design and marking are the most exposed teaching tasks; classroom teaching is low exposure.

pathways.title: Transform: Digital learning designer
pathways.summary: Apply teaching expertise to designing digital and blended learning materials that work for real classrooms and learners.
steps: Learn instructional design principles
Build one digital unit for your subject and test it with learners
Learn an authoring or learning-management tool
Collect evidence of what improved learning, and build a portfolio

evidence.note: Stresses developing human capacity for the responsible use of new technologies in education.

pathways.title: Discover: Learning and development in organisations
pathways.summary: Take teaching and mentoring skills into workplaces, where employers expect large-scale reskilling needs.
steps: Run a training session for adults, for example at a community group or business
Learn the basics of workplace learning needs analysis
Build a short course on a practical skill
Network with HR and training teams

evidence.note: Employers estimate that 59 out of every 100 workers would need training by 2030.

pathways.title: Adapt: AI-fluent visual designer
pathways.summary: Use generative tools for exploration and production, and compete on the parts AI does poorly: understanding the brief, cultural fit, originality and client relationships.
steps: Experiment with image-generation tools for moodboards and variations
Learn the licensing and copyright terms of the tools you use
Show your process, not only final images, in your portfolio
Specialise in a sector or local audience you understand well

evidence.note: Briefing and negotiating with clients are the least exposed design tasks.
Graphic designers appear just outside the top ten fastest-declining jobs, a first-time prediction.

pathways.title: Transform: UI and UX designer
pathways.summary: Apply visual skills to designing digital products: research users, design flows and build prototypes for apps and services.
steps: Learn user research and usability testing basics
Redesign a local app or service flow and test it with five users
Learn a prototyping tool and accessibility standards
Build two or three case studies showing problem, process and outcome

evidence.note: UI and UX designers are among the fastest-growing jobs, and design and user experience is a rising skill.

pathways.title: Discover: Brand and content strategy
pathways.summary: Move from making assets to deciding what should be made and why, by combining creative thinking with audience insight and marketing.
steps: Learn marketing fundamentals and audience research
Plan a content strategy for a small business or community organisation
Measure results with basic analytics
Position yourself as a creative strategist, not only a producer

evidence.note: Creative thinking is among the skills employers expect to rise most in importance.

pathways.title: Adapt: Digitally confident nurse
pathways.summary: Keep doing hands-on care while becoming confident with digital records, decision-support tools and telehealth.
steps: Become a confident user of the health information systems in your facility
Learn how decision-support tools work and where they can be wrong
Practise protecting patient data in digital systems
Act as a digital champion for colleagues

evidence.note: Hands-on nursing tasks are rated Very Low exposure; documentation and research tasks are higher.
Nursing professionals are among the care jobs expected to grow significantly.

pathways.title: Transform: Nurse educator or community health lead
pathways.summary: Build on health education and mentoring to train nurses and lead community health promotion.
steps: Take on precepting or mentoring of student nurses
Develop health education materials in local languages
Pursue further qualifications in nursing education or public health
Lead a community health promotion activity

evidence.note: WHO calls for investment in nursing education and the workforce to close shortages.

pathways.title: Discover: Health informatics
pathways.summary: Combine clinical knowledge with data and systems skills to improve how health information supports care.
steps: Learn data-analysis basics with health service data
Get involved in implementing or improving a records system
Study health informatics through a short course
Connect with digital health programmes in your county or organisation

evidence.note: AI and big data top the fastest-growing skills; technological literacy is also rising.
